name: Grimbly Wothis
description: A minotaur dock boss, half-man and half-bull, who employs Merret, bullies him and tries to seize his baby son.

timeline.summary: Grimbly Wothis orders Merret to clear the fog from the harbor for an investor, threatening to dock his pay.
timeline.quote: How's this for confidence . . . you don't clear it and you don't get your pay for today?

timeline.summary: Merret barely thins the fog and reveals a Simic schooner cloaking itself, which Wothis uses as a selling point to the investor.
timeline.quote: Fog swirls, barely, clearing about halfway to the other side of the river

timeline.summary: Empowered, Merret clears the whole harbor, then in a show-off moment casts a nightmare on the crane operator Yantis, dropping a crate of whiskey toward Wothis and the investor.
timeline.quote: Yantis screams, fighting all the terrifying nothings in front of him.

timeline.summary: Wothis shoves the investor into the river and jumps in as the crate smashes; Merret fears House Dimir will erase him.
timeline.quote: Nope, there's nothing covert about ruining a thousand zinos worth of cargo.

timeline.summary: Wothis breaks into the apartment, beats Merret and demands the child, saying he saw the candle trick through the window.
timeline.quote: I saw what that child did through the window, the trick with the candles.

timeline.summary: Merret weaves a nightmare in Wothis's mind but loses focus when Wothis nears Soche, and Wothis seizes the baby.
timeline.quote: And like that, my baby is in Grimbly Wothis's arms

timeline.summary: Wothis kicks Merret in the mouth and throws Tashi into a cabinet, breaking her ribs.
timeline.quote: With a hard shake, he flings her off.

timeline.summary: The baby gets magically gripped, vanishes from Wothis's arms and reappears on the floor holding a strange purple star-shaped fruit.
timeline.quote: My son arches his back again, throws his arms up, and suddenly, he's gone.

timeline.summary: Lazav orders Wothis to stay away from the family, and magically bends his will.
timeline.quote: Any outstanding debts Merret owes you will be paid in full by the close of business tomorrow

relations.note: Wothis is Merret's boss at the docks.
relations.quote: Merret!" says Grimbly Wothis, my boss
especially with what her husband pays me

relations.note: Wothis beats Merret and tries to take his son.
relations.quote: A child like this is worth something

pages_say.description: A minotaur dock boss, half-man and half-bull, who employs Merret, bullies him and tries to seize his baby son.
A minotaur imprisoned at Udzec, husband of Jitka.
